title: Bayer Foundation: Fellowship in Drug Discovery Sciences
summary: Financial support up to 10,000 EUR for up to 6 months for Master's and PhD students from natural sciences, pharmacy, or data science undertaking study projects, practical work experience, or research in Germany.

degree_levels.notes: Master's and PhD students / graduates and doctoral candidates/PhD students

subject_areas.notes: Target group lists natural science, pharmacy, data science; description also mentions all scientific disciplines with relevance to pharmaceutical and consumer healthcare industries.

institutions.notes: Specific host institutions are not restricted or named on the page.

nationality.notes: A dropdown list of countries is shown on the page for application selection, but no specific eligible/excluded nationality list is explicitly defined in the text.

residence.notes: Students from Germany going abroad or students from abroad studying, researching or doing an internship in Germany can apply.

mandatory.text: Enrolment in a Master's or PhD programme
Strong sense of commitment and motivation
Submit an innovative research proposal with fundamental or applied studies relevant to pharmaceutical and consumer healthcare industries

funding.description: Individual financial funding up to 10,000 EUR.

application_rounds.notes: Deadlines are external and updated on the Bayer Foundation website.

steps.text: Find application forms and further information on the application procedure on the Bayer Foundation website.

sources.title: Bayer Foundation: Fellowship in Drug Discovery Sciences - DAAD - Deutscher Akademischer Austauschdienst
sources.notes: The scholarship is open to students from abroad who are studying, researching or doing an internship in Germany, covering Master's and PhD levels.
